1000annonces-7e97953651.description: A vendre appartement à Cascavelle (Ile Maurice), 16500000 MUR, 94.1 m², 3 pièces
1000annonces-7e97953651.details: / Ile Maurice / Cascavelle / Vente – APPARTEMENT 3 CHAMBRES – CASCAVELLE OU... À VENDRE – APPARTEMENT DE 3 CHAMBRES – CASCAVELLE, OUEST 3 pièces 310 353€ / 16 500 000 MUR Cascavelle 94.1 m² surface Description du T3 à Cascavelle Une terrasse privée sur le toit, une vue sur Le Morne, et tout déjà en place. Appartement situé au deuxième étage à Green Creek Estate, Cascavelle, dans une petite résidence bien entretenue derrière un portail automatisé, avec un espace vert ouvert juste derrière le bâtiment. L’appartement offre 94,10 m² d’espace habitable, comprenant 3 chambres, dont une avec sa salle de bains attenante, ainsi qu’une salle de bains commune, deux terrasses couvertes et un espace ouvert salon, salle à manger et cuisine. La climatisation est installée partout, dans chaque chambre ainsi que dans le salon. La cuisine est entièrement équipée, avec les appareils inclus, et l’appartement est vendu entièrement meublé. Rien à ajouter, rien à prévoir. Ce qui distingue cet appartement, c’est la terrasse sur le toit. Un escalier intérieur, partagé avec une seule unité voisine, mène à une terrasse privée de 100 m². Une fois en haut, elle vous appartient à vous seul, ce n’est pas un espace commun. La terrasse est ombragée, dispose d’une table en béton, et offre une vue sur Le Morne et les montagnes environnantes. Les résidents ont également accès à une piscine commune. L’emplacement permet de rejoindre facilement Cascavelle Mall, la salle de sport SPARC, Westcoast School et Middles

immo23-ap55974ve.title: 3-bed apartment 120 m², Curepipe

immo23-du48326ve.title: 2-bed duplex in gated residence with pool, Grand Gaube

immo23-ma15212ve.title: 5-bed family house, Quatre Bornes

immo23-ma24021ve.details: Recently built single-family house of about 90 m² on 57 toises. Lounge and dining with an open kitchen, two air-conditioned bedrooms and a shared bathroom. immo23-ma24021ve.title: Recent 2-bed house, Beau Bassin (57 toises)

immo23-ma26661ve.description: Large 10-bed two-level house (~279 m², built 1978–85) on 127 toises, garage for 4 cars.

immo23-ma26661ve.title: 10-bed family house, Curepipe

immo23-ma70435ve.description: 3-bed two-storey house, 250 m² on 228 m², sea & mountain views, big terrace; needs modernising.

immo23-ma78120ve.details: Semi-furnished family home of 400 m² on 25 perches in a quiet upmarket part of Curepipe. Four bedrooms, three en suite, with dressing room. American-style kitchen, separate living and dining rooms and a TV lounge. Landscaped garden, carport and automated gate.

immohub-apartment-in-riviere-des-galets.title: 1-bed apartment with sea view & pool, Rivière des Galets

zafer-05b928d8-cf7d-465d-a758-094cfb7318.description: Posted today on zafer.mu: 470 m² plot in the Serenis morcellement, Albion, Rs 5.5M via Nenuphar.
zafer-05b928d8-cf7d-465d-a758-094cfb7318.details: A 470 m² (11.1 perches) residential plot in Morcellement Serenis, Albion, on the west coast. It is offered as a site for building a family house. The agency gives no detail on services, view or plot shape. Viewings are arranged by WhatsApp.
zafer-05b928d8-cf7d-465d-a758-094cfb7318.title: Residential plot 470 m² (11.1 perches), Morcellement Serenis – Albion

zafer-093e4b1d-274f-47c8-a584-f7fcc11862.description: Approx. posted 14 Oct on Zafer: furnished 50 m² 1-bed flat 100 m from the beach, shared pool; eligibility unclear.
zafer-093e4b1d-274f-47c8-a584-f7fcc11862.details: Furnished one-bedroom apartment of about 50 m² on the first floor of the Be Cosy residence, roughly 100 m from Trou aux Biches beach. Secure residence with shared pool and private parking. Air-conditioned, equipped kitchen and a terrace/balcony. Marketed as a second home or holiday-rental investment; the ad does not say whether foreigners can buy.
zafer-093e4b1d-274f-47c8-a584-f7fcc11862.title: 1-bed furnished apartment, Be Cosy residence – Trou aux Biches

zafer-2c4fa4da-8b32-45d0-9957-08b9a71512.description: Posted 22 Jul 2026 (updated 23 Sep). Built 2025, owner resale steps from the beach; eligibility unclear; size not shown.
zafer-2c4fa4da-8b32-45d0-9957-08b9a71512.details: A ground-floor three-bedroom apartment (two en-suite plus a common bathroom) on the Trou aux Biches coastal road, a few steps from the beach. Built in 2025, it is sold fully furnished with a generator. It has a private garden and veranda with jacuzzi, open kitchen plus separate grease kitchen, and air conditioning in the living area. The building has fibre, CCTV, an automated gate and parking for two cars. The owner would also consider a long-term let.
zafer-2c4fa4da-8b32-45d0-9957-08b9a71512.title: 3-bed ground-floor apartment with garden & jacuzzi, coastal road – Trou aux Biches

zafer-2ca05f5a-f83c-41a7-8298-709324fb61.description: Posted 2 Sep 2026 (updated 10 Oct). 2nd-floor renovated flat near Curepipe bus station, sold furnished with covered parking.
zafer-2ca05f5a-f83c-41a7-8298-709324fb61.details: A 71 m² two-bedroom apartment on the second floor of an older block just off Lees Avenue, Curepipe; access is by stairs (no lift). It was renovated a few years ago and is sold fully furnished with appliances. There is a living/dining room, kitchen, laundry area and a small office or terrace with a green outlook. A 13.5 m² covered parking space and a shared garden are included. Manhattan Complex and the bus station are within walking distance.
zafer-2ca05f5a-f83c-41a7-8298-709324fb61.title: Renovated 2-bed furnished apartment 71 m², off Lees Avenue – Curepipe

zafer-43e13d2d-3f51-425a-b094-334c915c1a.description: Posted ≈ 22 Oct 2026 (approx., '8h ago'). Renovated 2-bed duplex with small garden in guarded complex near Melville beach; OFIM exclusive.
zafer-43e13d2d-3f51-425a-b094-334c915c1a.details: Recently renovated two-storey duplex in a guarded residence with a remote-controlled gate. Ground floor has an open kitchen and living room opening onto a small private garden. Upstairs are two air-conditioned bedrooms, one with a terrace, and a shower room. Residents share two pools, and Melville beach is about 5 minutes by car. Syndic is Rs 7,000 per quarter; agency fee 2% + VAT.
zafer-43e13d2d-3f51-425a-b094-334c915c1a.title: Renovated 2-bed duplex in secured complex, Melville (Grand Gaube)

zafer-6327934d-11a9-4338-9d05-998aed87d2.description: Posted 22 Jul 2026 (updated 29 Aug). ~34-year-old well-kept house with garage and garden, sold furnished; immediate occupancy.
zafer-6327934d-11a9-4338-9d05-998aed87d2.details: A two-storey family house of about 34 years on 350 m² (8.3 perches) at 16ème Mille, Forest Side. The ground floor has an entrance, living/dining area, American-style fitted kitchen, TV room, bathroom and an enclosed garage. Upstairs are three bedrooms, a second bathroom and a large balcony. It is described as well maintained and is sold fully furnished with teak furniture. Outside there is a tended garden and extra open space.
zafer-6327934d-11a9-4338-9d05-998aed87d2.title: Furnished 3-bed two-storey family house on 350 m², 16ème Mille – Forest Side

zafer-6f034a9c-2c16-4191-987b-4ef9cadf7d.description: Posted ≈ 22 Oct 2026 (approx., '12h ago'). 120-perch agricultural plot in Goodlands with two accesses; villa allowed on 20%.
zafer-6f034a9c-2c16-4191-987b-4ef9cadf7d.details: Agricultural plot of 120 perches (about 5,065 m²) in a quiet part of Goodlands. It has two access points, with water and electricity available in the area. A house such as a villa may be built on up to 20% of the land, subject to permits. Animal farming is not allowed.
zafer-6f034a9c-2c16-4191-987b-4ef9cadf7d.title: Agricultural land 120 perches (5,065 m²), Goodlands

zafer-91564c3f-0945-4a8f-bcff-b08e389b0e.description: Approx. posted 16 Oct on Zafer: furnished 2021 villa with pool in a 5-house complex, Péreybère. Contact via Zafer form only.
zafer-91564c3f-0945-4a8f-bcff-b08e389b0e.details: Single-storey villa built in 2021 and sold furnished, in a small co-ownership of five houses on Chemin 20 Pieds. Three air-conditioned bedrooms (one en suite) and two shower rooms, open-plan kitchen/dining/lounge opening onto the pool through large windows, and a 45 m² veranda. Private garden with kiosk, laundry room and one parking space. Electric fencing and CCTV; no houses directly overlook it. Plot given as 4.6 perches (≈194 m²).
zafer-91564c3f-0945-4a8f-bcff-b08e389b0e.title: 3-bed single-storey villa with pool (built 2021) – Péreybère

zafer-e31f8282-d670-407c-a59c-869a2346b3.description: Posted ≈ 22 Oct 2026 (approx., '12h ago'). 5-bed family house, 278 m² on 7.2 perches with private pool, near the Albion coast.
zafer-e31f8282-d670-407c-a59c-869a2346b3.details: Spacious family house in a residential part of Albion close to the west coast. Five bedrooms with three bathrooms and three toilets, about 278 m² habitable on a 303 m² (7.2 perches) plot. Open-plan kitchen, balcony with mountain views and three verandas. Private swimming pool. Year built not stated.
zafer-e31f8282-d670-407c-a59c-869a2346b3.title: 5-bed house with private pool, Albion

zafer-fd0ae863-ab7a-44e8-9a1f-4374a32f66.description: Posted 22 Jul 2026 (updated 9 Oct). 10-perch plot in a quiet villa street, stone-walled on three sides; beach ~5 min.
zafer-fd0ae863-ab7a-44e8-9a1f-4374a32f66.details: A 422 m² (10 perches) residential plot on Chevreau Lane in a quiet part of Calodyne, surrounded by villas. Natural-stone boundary walls already enclose three sides, which the seller counts as included in the price. The beach and Intermart Calodyne are about five minutes away. It is pitched for a family home or a buy-to-let project.
zafer-fd0ae863-ab7a-44e8-9a1f-4374a32f66.title: Walled residential plot 422 m² (10 perches), Chevreau Lane – Calodyne
